# Developer Workflows
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## Golden Path (Full Feature Lifecycle)

| Step | Skill | Input | Output | Artifact |
|------|-------|-------|--------|---------|
| **0. Bootstrap** | `/speckit.init` | — | `docs.AI/` + confirm templates | `docs.AI/*.md` |
| **0b. Templates** | `/ai-radija-setup-templates` | — | Editable template files | `specs/.templates/*.md` |
| **1. Design review** | `/ai-radija-grill-me` | Feature idea | Go/No-Go + 8–10 critical questions | — |
| **2. Specify** | `/ai-radija-specify` | Approved idea | User stories + AC | `specs/<NNN>/spec.md` |
| **3. Clarify** | `/ai-radija-clarify` | Ambiguous spec | Refined spec | `specs/<NNN>/spec.md` (updated) |
| **4. Plan** | `/ai-radija-plan` | Spec + codebase | Data model + contracts + research | `specs/<NNN>/plan.md` |
| **5. Tasks** | `/ai-radija-tasks` | Plan + spec | Ordered task list | `specs/<NNN>/tasks.md` |
| **6. TDD** | `/ai-radija-tdd` | Tasks + AC | Test cycles RED/GREEN/REFACTOR | Tests + implementation |
| **7. Implement** | `/ai-radija-implement` | tasks.md + test plan | Full implementation with tests | Source code |
| **8. PR** | `/ai-radija-pr-ready` | Branch + code | PR checklist + formatted PR | Pull request |

---

## Session Start Checklist (AI Agent)

At the start of every session, before invoking any skill:

1. Check `docs.AI/1_README.AI.md` — if missing, run `/speckit.init`
2. Check `specs/.templates/` — if missing, suggest `/ai-radija-setup-templates`
3. List files in `specs/.templates/` and ask which templates are active this session
4. Read `specs/feature.json` to determine the active feature directory
5. Check `CLAUDE.md` for tracker configuration

---

## Tracker Workflow (when tracker is configured)

```
tasks.md  →  /ai-radija-tasks-to-issues  →  GitHub Issues
tasks.md  →  /ai-radija-tracker-ado      →  Azure DevOps PBIs
tasks.md  →  /ai-radija-tracker-jira     →  Jira Stories
```

---

## PRD-First Workflow (alternative to Golden Path)

For teams that start with a Product Requirements Document:

```
/ai-radija-write-a-prd  →  PRD document
/ai-radija-prd-to-issues  →  Vertical-slice tasks + tracker issues
/ai-radija-tdd  →  Implementation
/ai-radija-pr-ready  →  Pull request
```

---

## Governance Workflow

```
/ai-radija-constitution  →  specs/memory/constitution.md
/ai-radija-grill-me      →  validates new feature against constitution
```

---

## Skill Command Reference

```bash
# Bootstrap
/speckit.init                   # First session: create docs.AI/ + check templates
/ai-radija-setup-templates       # Create specs/.templates/ with defaults
/ai-radija-tracker-setup         # Configure ADO / Jira / GitHub / Linear / Notion

# Feature workflow
/ai-radija-grill-me <idea>       # Design review
/ai-radija-specify <description> # Create spec
/ai-radija-clarify               # Refine spec
/ai-radija-plan                  # Create implementation plan
/ai-radija-tasks                 # Break plan into tasks
/ai-radija-tdd                   # TDD loop
/ai-radija-implement             # Execute all tasks
/ai-radija-pr-ready              # Validate + create PR

# Tracker
/ai-radija-tasks-to-issues       # Push tasks to GitHub Issues
/ai-radija-tracker-ado           # Push tasks to Azure DevOps
/ai-radija-tracker-jira          # Push tasks to Jira

# Quality
/ai-radija-analyze               # Cross-check spec/plan/tasks consistency
/ai-radija-checklist             # Validate requirements quality

# Utilities
/ai-radija-constitution          # Define governance rules
/ai-radija-write-a-skill         # Create a new skill
/ai-radija-write-a-prd           # Full PRD via interview
/ai-radija-prd-to-issues         # Break PRD into vertical-slice issues
```
